scientific_integrity: Exact matching enumeration and an all-size factorial-ratio bound prove the main theorem. Finite checker results supplement, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive c, exactly balanced labelled three-part complete graphs, equal equilibrium dimer activities n/c. Covariance signs are asymptotic, not claimed for every finite n; no independence or priority certification.
title: Parity-conditioned Poisson monomers and opposite covariance signs in tripartite dimer gases
